raw_text: Root: Next.js/TypeScript strict, noEmit; App Router in `src/app`; UI `src/components`; hooks `src/hooks`; utilities `src/lib`; assets `public/`; scripts `scripts/`; Vite `vite-base-template/`. Alias `@/*`→`src/*`; Tailwind v4; 2 spaces; conventions. Commands: `npm run dev`; `npm run build`; `npm run start`; `npm run lint`; `cd vite-base-template && npm run dev`; `npm --prefix vite-base-template run build`. No test runner; prefer Vitest/Jest+RTL; tests adjacent or `__tests__/`; critical coverage. PRs: summary/rationale, local test steps/screenshots, linked issues/checklist. Use `.env.local`; do not commit secrets. `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` client-exposed. Rotate leaked credentials promptly; prefer per-env keys. Rewrites `/iframe/*`→`src/app/api/iframe`.
